//: The DMS workbook's layout, moved out of code so a second application can have its own (ECOM-0 A1). EMITTED from FINAL_TEST_CASES_SCHEMA rather than typed, so it cannot differ from it by a transcription error; tests/unit/sheet-layout.spec.ts then asserts the two are equal, field by field, because the duplication is a performance decision and a drift here would change a VERDICT rather than a message.
//positional: Validated BY POSITION, never keyed by name, and this sheet is why: "Issue No." appears at BOTH column 17 and column 20, so a name-keyed reader silently takes whichever it finds first — and column 19 is "SOC DMS " with a trailing space, so an exact-name lookup misses it entirely. The reader trims before comparing, which is a deliberate tolerance rather than an accident.
//outputColumns: The LAST MANUAL RUN's outcome, not input. Reading Status as an expectation would inherit a stale human verdict as a requirement — worse than a generated case, because an old pass/fail looks authoritative. The loader refuses a column declared both as an output and as an input field.
//clauseSeparator: Measured: 37 of 470 `And` cells join two clauses with this.
